metadata.title: Theory of Everything Research Programme: B2 Causal Maintenance Network Confirmatory Dataset and Decision Record.
metadata.description:
This release contains the original confirmatory dataset, provenance records, preregistered analysis and decision record for B2, the causal-maintenance experiment in Experimental Block I of the Theory of Everything Research Programme.

The study was publicly preregistered before held-out confirmatory execution at OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/GQANP. Twenty held-out seeds were used across seven frozen confirmatory conditions covering low, medium and high disturbance, external-support withdrawal, targeted C1 ablation, specific functional rescue and equal-budget irrelevant rescue. Five architecture classes were evaluated: passive persistence, external maintenance, internal feed-forward maintenance, reciprocal internal maintenance and a budget-matched brute-force internal bypass.

The preregistered result is mixed. H1.1 (active-maintenance advantage), H1.2 (internal autonomy after support withdrawal), H1.3 (topology-specific reciprocal failure propagation) and H1.4 (specific functional rescue) were RETAINED. H1.5 (boundary/timescale robustness) remained DEFERRED as preregistered. H1.6 was REDUCED as a reciprocal-topology necessity claim because the budget-matched brute-force bypass satisfied every registered non-inferiority condition.

The archive includes the original raw JSONL trajectories from all completed provenance-valid confirmatory runs, seed registries, events, provenance and file manifests, the technically interrupted first C1-ablation attempt preserved as an excluded audit trace, per-seed derived metrics, bootstrap uncertainty summaries, confirmatory figure, machine-readable decision record, independent analysis-regeneration check and packaging-repair audit.

The result supports artificial functional/causal internal maintenance within the registered three-component architecture family while showing that reciprocal closure-like topology is not necessary for the measured capacity in that family. It does not establish biological life, universal organisational closure, the historical origin of life, intelligence, consciousness, or universal necessity for Transition Problem 1.
